source.note: Wave-1 P1 #87 is a gap (no free schoolgirl model found; PLAN.md suggests outfitting a Kenney mini character). This is a recolour of the library's mini-female-c (Kenney Mini Characters, character-female-c.fbx): same fetch, member and pins, only roles, colours, height and name differ. It was picked over the Quaternius women (woman-casual, woman-casual-2/woman-dress, woman-suit) because it is the only female base with a skirt: the Quaternius women all wear trousers, and woman-suit's jacket and trousers are one material. Its colour-map clusters separate top, waistband, skirt, headband, bead necklace, hair, soles and skin, so the uniform is painted by role mapping alone: white top, navy high-waisted pleat-less skirt (waistband + skirt), the bead necklace as a red neck ribbon, the headband as a red hair ribbon, black hair. Her tights share Kenney's hair swatch, so they read as dark tights; the necklace swatch also paints a band at each ankle (red cuffs); the shoe uppers share the face's skin swatch and stay skin-toned (no loafers possible by role mapping). Height 1.55 m (a teen); Kenney minis are chibi (head about 40 % of the body), so at teen height the head is large: that is the kit's style. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane by her probed depths at this height (set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height).
